Th e ﬁ nal phase of swallowing is the esophageal phase. Th e 
upper esophageal sphincter (UES) or pharyngoesophageal 
sphincter is located at the top of the esophagus. Th is sphincter, 
when open, allows the bolus to enter the esophagus. When
the sphincter is closed, it prevents air from entering the GI
tract during breathing. After the bolus of food moves through
the UES into the esophagus, the sphincter closes and normal 
breathing will resume.
